lap_time_benchmark_conditioning: continuous residual benchmark filters explicitly to lap_time_observed=true after target-free event-relative feature construction

target.censored_bags: bags with no legal Qualifying lap remain in source evidence with lap_time_observed=false and are counted but excluded from this continuous residual fit and score
target.model_training_target: source-adjusted residual centered by its training event median, which is algebraically the driver residual minus that training event median
target.name: source_shift_adjusted_driver_relative_qualifying_residual_seconds
target.source_shift: event-balanced median rehearsal-to-Q residual among strictly prior events with the same rehearsal_source; global prior-event median fallback
target.truth: best legal Grand Prix Qualifying lap conditional on has_legal_qualifying_lap=true

temporal_capacity_diagnostic.trace_caveat: training size and target event change together; the slope is descriptive and cannot identify a causal learning-curve plateau
